title: While My Guitar Gently Weeps — Ukulele Song-Form Accompaniment
tonalCenter: A minor, A major middle section
description: Playable, song-structured high-G ukulele accompaniment using the documented harmony and characteristic rhythmic feel of “While My Guitar Gently Weeps”. Designed for practice, not a note-for-note original guitar, vocal, bass or lead-riff transcription.
body:
Introduction: Am | G | D | F | Am | G | F | E7 (repeat 1×)
Verse 1: Am | G | D | F | Am | G | C | E7 (repeat 2×)
Verse 2: Am | G | D | F | Am | G | C | E7 (repeat 1×)
Middle (A major): A | C#m | F#m | Bm | E7 | A | E7 | A (repeat 2×)
Verse 3: Am | G | D | F | Am | G | C | E7 (repeat 2×)
Instrumental: Am | G | D | F | Am | G | F | E7 (repeat 1×)
Final verse: Am | G | D | F | Am | G | C | E7 (repeat 1×)
Outro: Am | G | F | E7 | Am (repeat 1×)
notes:
High-G GCEA, no capo; concert pitch. Descending chord movement in minor verses and a luminous A-major middle section. No Clapton solo transcription.
Score section map: Introduction (1–8) · Verse 1 (9–24) · Verse 2 (25–32) · Middle (A major) (33–48) · Verse 3 (49–64) · Instrumental (65–72) · Final verse (73–80) · Outro (81–85).
Original meter where supported; some rhythmic/meter details are adapted to the current single-meter, single-voice score engine. Rhythmic parts are original and song-characteristic, not copied riffs. Slash-bass/inversion details beyond the ukulele range are omitted.
Source harmonies: https://www.musicradar.com/music-tech/recording/i-was-with-eric-clapton-and-said-why-dont-you-come-to-the-studio-and-play-on-this-song-he-said-oh-no-i-cant-do-that-nobodys-ever-played-on-a-beatles-record-the-theory-behind-the-beatles-while-my-guitar-gently-weeps
